name: Fidelity-Research
description:
## Description

"Shell-integrated MC cartridge carefully designed for music playback.A fully air-core coil that does not use a winding frame for the generator coil is incorporated into a 2-magnet 4-pole magnetic circuit.The cantilever is directly connected to the coil wound with 16turns for each left and right channel, and the effective mass of the vibrator is reduced by setting the air-core coil at the position where the effective mass is the smallest considering the vibration mode.The power generation coil is made of pure silver wire, which is 7% more efficient than using copper wires.The FR-7uses a push-pull power generation system to improve electrical conversion efficiency and increase output power as well as output voltage.In addition, push-pull power generation eliminates the canceling voltage improves phase characteristics and crosstalk characteristics.In order to hold the cartridge unit firmly, the flat surface of the shell body has been reduced as much as possible. In addition, the lead-out wire of the generator coil have been made as short as possible, and thick wires have been soldered to eliminate concerns about shell lead wires.The cartridge body is mounted on a base made of machined aluminum block.It was possible to replace FR-7f with an internal unit."

name: Fidelity-Research
description:
## Description

"Shell-integrated MC cartridge, an improved version of FR-7.It uses a unique push-pull power generation system with a magnetic circuit consisting of two magnets and four poles.In this system, power is generated at four locations, so that a sufficiently large output voltage can be obtained even with a low-impedance coil. In addition, while the general system generates a cancellation current in the power generation circuit, the FR-7f magnetic circuit can be obtained as a positive output even in the conventional cancellation current generation region. This improves the phase and crosstalk characteristics, greatly increases the electrical conversion efficiency, and improves the output power.Samarium-cobalt magnets are used as magnetic circuit materials. These magnets have superior characteristics such as high coercive force and resistance to self-demagnetization compared with ordinary alnico magnets, and retain the initial characteristics of the magnetic circuit over a long period of time.A fully air-core coil without a winding frame is used for the power generation coil, and unnecessary magnetic materials do not move in the power generation magnetic field, and distortion of the reproduced signal is fundamentally removed. The effective mass of the vibrator can also be reduced to approximately 2/3, and high-frequency mechanical impedance is reduced.The needle tip uses a unique refined contact needle with special polishing of solid 0.15mm square solid diamond.The Refined Contact Needle is a new method that combines the advantages of the line contact needle with the advantages of the elliptical needle. It is less susceptible to adverse effects (noise, etc.) from disc sleds and dust in the sound groove. It also produces very little scratch noise or surface noise, so you can enjoy sound reproduction with good clarity and no fatigue.Special aluminum alloy cantilever is used for the cantilever.This is a straight cantilever made of highly corrosion-resistant special aluminum alloy and subjected to an optimum heat-curing treatment (ceramic treatment). It is made to minimize moment of inertia and deflection during high-speed motion.By adopting a structure in which the head part of the string holder extends to the front of the damper B, the position of the supporting point is made more clear. By this, the position of the cantilever vibration supporting point is made more clear, and the change in the vibration distance of the cantilever at each frequency is minimized.In addition, the string wire that applies tension to the cantilever is made of a material with a high spring coefficient and little aging, which contributes to the improvement of the square wave characteristics.It adopts a double damper system, and by adopting a damper structure of two layers with different rubber coefficients, it effectively dumps both middle and low frequencies of vibration, making it possible to make an ideal trace over the entire reproduction frequency.In addition, the rubber coefficients of damper A and damper B are different, so that the effect of temperature on trace performance, mechanical impedance characteristics, and playback sound is totally reduced.In order to solve the problem that the coil lead wire vibrates with the cantilever, the coil lead wire is inserted between the damper A and B and press-bonded to eliminate unnecessary power generation caused by the lead wire.The head shell part is designed to completely eliminate dead space which causes parasitic vibration harmful to sound quality. In addition, the shell part is made of special aluminum alloy. By impact processing (cold forging), rigidity is further increased and generation of split resonance is proposed.The cartridge body is made of epoxy resin that has been selected through careful audibility testing.In order to improve the insufficient strength due to the looseness of the arm and connector part, a special stainless steel lock plate is adopted instead of the conventional guide pin. By this, the connection with the arm can be more integrated, and the horizontal level can be maintained correctly."

name: Fidelity-Research
description:
## Description

"Toroidal step-up transformer designed exclusively for low impedance MC type cartridges.The transformer core material is made of super-permalloy-based alloy, which has about four times the core volume of conventional core material. In order to take advantage of the superior characteristics of this core material, we have adopted a ring-shaped core with a laminate structure in which hundreds of concentric layers of 0.05mm-thick rolled core material are wound in concentric circles, further improving the high-frequency characteristics.In addition, by applying special hardening and insulating treatment to the surface of the core, the conventional core casing is not required, and the toroidal winding is applied almost in the state of close contact winding, so the winding length can be shortened even though the core volume is increased, and signal transmission loss is reduced.In order to make the left and right channels exactly the same condition, the toroidal transformer unit, the shield drain and the left and right channels of the output are completely independent. This greatly reduces the electrical and magnetic crosstalk of the left and right channels.Careful 4-layered shield made of 78% permalloy prevents the influence of external induction etc.0.8� mm oxygen-free copper wire is used for the internal wiring material to improve the vibration and transmission loss of the wiring itself. In addition, the toroidal transformer unit has achieved 1/2or less resistance on both primary and secondary sides by winding, contributing to the improvement of transformer conversion efficiency and the increase of information quantity.The input / output terminals use highly reliable, high contact pressure pin jacks and pin plugs with thick film, hard gold plating."

name: Fidelity-Research
description:
## Description

"This is a universal tone arm that inherits FR-24technology and has a wide range of adaptability.A miniature bearing with high precision is used for the rotation support mechanism. In addition, the weight of the movable part of the arm is small, and the inertia efficiency is small, and high performance is obtained, and stable tracking is realized.An aluminum light alloy pipe with a large outer diameter is used for the arm support part in the vertical rotation direction to absorb resonance.It also helps to improve machining accuracy of the rotation support mechanism.An aluminum alloy pipe with an outer diameter of 8mm is used for the arm part to suppress resonance and reduce the mass of the entire arm to enable light needle pressure operation.The cartridge mounting shell is made of pressed aluminum alloy with a thickness of 1mm.The rotation support part prevents resonance by using a resonance prevention device that absorbs reverse resonance caused by needle pressure weight and balance weight, and a side balancer for needle pressure with built-in damping material.In addition to adjusting the lateral balance, it is equipped with a side balancer equipped with a needle pressure application device that can accurately set the needle pressure weight within the range of 0~ 5g.In the past, the lateral balancer and needle pressure application weight were separated individually, but in the FR-34, these two adjustments can be performed simultaneously, realizing a significant reduction in weight.The needle pressure adjustment can be read directly from 0to 5grams in 0.5g steps. Precise adjustment is possible without a needle pressure system. In addition, the needle pressure weight adopts a new mechanism that clicks and stops at every scale.It is equipped with a slide base, and when foreign heads such as Orthophone or heads of domestic manufacturers are attached to FR-34, the needle tip position of each different cartridge can be corrected with a knob.This base is also useful against vibration from the floor and prevents the S / N ratio and dynamic range from decreasing.The head shell part is common with FR-24, and it is a European standard 4-terminal type.The lead wire at the base of the arm is a 5-terminal type unique to FR and does not require soldering.The tip of the leader has a standard molded plug that fits into a common pin plug.By changing the adjustment range of the scale to full scale 0~ 2.5g, the weight for light needle pressure which can determine the needle pressure more accurately was sold separately."
